output_forge.method_note: Output Forge renders the finished run-state into deliverables and records each artifact's SHA-256. The HTML dashboard is self-contained and needs no backend; the Office formats need their optional packages and are skipped, not failed, when a backend is absent. All timestamps are pinned to the run timestamp so a re-run on the same input reproduces the same bytes.
